tests.input: Create a React button component with TypeScript

tests.description: Identify code smells in a function
tests.input: Analyze this code for issues: function getData() { var x = 1; return fetch('/api'); }
Document this function: async function fetchUser(id: string): Promise<User>
Refactor this nested if statement: if (user) { if (user.isActive) { if (user.hasPermission) { doAction(); } } }

grading.criteria: Suggests early returns or guard clauses to reduce nesting

tests.description: Identify the bug in async code
tests.input: Find the bug: async function loadData() { const data = fetch('/api/data'); return data.json(); }

tests.description: Recommend architecture pattern for real-time chat
tests.input: What architecture pattern should I use for a real-time chat application?

grading.criteria: Mentions WebSockets or real-time messaging patterns

tests.input: What's wrong with this code? const query = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' + userId;

tests.description: Write a unit test for a function
tests.input: Write a unit test for: function add(a: number, b: number): number { return a + b; }
Optimize this code: for(let i=0; i<arr.length; i++) { if(arr[i].id === targetId) return arr[i]; }

grading.criteria: Suggests using Array.find() or similar built-in method

tests.input: Explain when to use git rebase vs git merge

grading.criteria: Explains the difference between linear history (rebase) and merge commits
